findings.text: follow-on: the driver's full arm JSONs, which carry the proc_io rchar deltas the landing quotes (recovery.py read 1,788,437,710 B to 168,705,172 B), are written only under the node-local $TMPDIR scratch and are not copied into the run directory; measure-console.txt keeps only the pidstat summary, so once the scratch is reaped the read figures cannot be reconciled from a durable log the run directory holds.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 65370f6d; recovery.py adds the memo, the alive-gate and the byte counter, the test adds one case, and the fragment records the landing and reconciles with the arm JSONs.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names a case asserting a poll over unchanged runs reads zero admission bytes; tests/test_producer_reads_only_what_changed.py:305 is that case, and the manifest records the gate at 49 passed base and 50 passed head, EXIT=0 for both arms.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the live producer's per-poll stream reads scale with the bytes appended rather than total stream size; the landed change gates the admission scan to the dead-process arm (reckon/crew/recovery.py:6167) and memoises its result by the stream's stat identity (reckon/crew/recovery.py:3417), which is the whole-stream read the goal names.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commits 6fd52ac3d and 12bf09030, both gate arms with zero added failures (49 passed base, 50 passed head), the negative-control log path, and the fleet-node before/after figures.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_producer_reads_only_what_changed.py and the evidence fragment; the diff 65370f6d..12bf09030 touches only those three paths.

justifications.durability: tests/test_producer_reads_only_what_changed.py:339 asserts a module-level counter the test does not supply, and the negative control shows the case redden to [2682, 2682, 905220] once the whole-stream scan is restored.
justifications.evidence: gate-base.log (49 passed) and gate-head.log (50 passed) are recorded with EXIT=0 and the negative control reddens at tests/test_producer_reads_only_what_changed.py:336, but the raw rchar arm JSONs carrying the landing's read figures sit only on node-local scratch.
justifications.fit: the new names take_admission_stream_bytes and _count_admission_bytes follow the surrounding idiom in reckon/crew/recovery.py:5635 and carry no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:6167 skips the scan unless alive is False, so a live run reads nothing on this path, and the arm JSONs show the steady-window read falling from 800,136,647 B to 31,343,418 B.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 65370f6d..12bf09030 changes exactly the three paths the manifest declares, with no file outside them and nothing the goal does not imply.
